title: Consolidate publishable-content interactions across web and mobile
body:
Consolidates fan-club and event-moment engagement into one capability-gated interaction layer for web and mobile. Reactions, transactional counts, cursor-paginated comments/replies, tombstones, stable mentions, owner policies, scoped moderation, blocking, notification preferences and exact discussion links share server authorization and persistence. Existing engagement IDs and URLs remain compatible; legacy writers delegate to the canonical model after an atomic, audited conversion.

Covered publications: club posts/memories, events/moments, recordings/sessions, record releases, artist releases, classifieds/opportunities and published directory profiles. Attached media shares its publication's discussion. Imported artist social-sync records remain disabled without explicit publication authority. Owners may hide/restore comments but gain no administrator removal or report-decision powers. Privacy, current source permissions, blocking, suspension and revision checks remain authoritative.

The manifest has **159 immutable migrations**: the 116 current-main entries, then eight social compatibility prerequisites and 35 interaction migrations. Integration with main's event-ingestion PR #469 preserves both CI/release gates, SQL bytes and original introduction commits. Activation validates and converts nonempty legacy engagement and permanently fences legacy writes in one transaction. Emergency pause serializes with admitted commands and delivery while preserving authorized canonical reads. Recovery repairs forward without reopening old writers or overwriting accepted writes.

Final review repairs:

- Resolved reports reopen only after an actual content edit, preserving prior evidence. New request keys, no-op edits and hide/restore cannot reset the baseline.
- Existing club reactions remain available before first activation through an explicit, non-cacheable server response. Ordinary authorization/not-found errors and converted pauses cannot enable legacy UI.
- Recordings, sessions and record releases require membership in matching active/published editorial collections. Moderation does not bypass publication. Comments serialize with membership deletion and collection withdrawal; hidden discussions retain their engagement for republication.

- Published record links outside the first 200 feed members or without a preview resolve through one authorized detail lookup. Existing discussions remain reachable without making feed position/media availability a publication grant. Ordinary browsing continues to exclude unavailable-media cards.

- Refreshing a feed now reselects the linked item when its index crosses a page boundary. Unchanged selection preserves user pagination. Five rendered source-kind cases and five real-browser configurations prove both movement directions, exact focus and bounded rendering.
- Classifieds/opportunities require strictly future expiry, matching the existing public detail endpoint. Null/current/past expiry deny summaries, writes, registration and links for ordinary users and moderators; renewal restores existing identities/counts without changing source or engagement data. The pre-fix regression failed; SQL and real HTTP regressions pass.

Verification:

- Independently approved head **fd87416e99af3176d107178832f238ef00003be5** passed [required CI](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36701303422) and merged through normal protection as **645f56fcc44f81609fbfd0e03d683b40376ce77a**, preserving the reviewed tree and migration ancestry. All post-merge workflows pass, including the [exact merged-image build](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36703425146). Immutable image: `sha256:38e6264b82db2d81a5b51c3a78740b6a305538b4cdae8d53ced067ccbb1e8fe0`. Its source, architecture and embedded migration bytes are independently verified on Hetzner. [Final installed iOS qualification](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36700761570) passed against identical backend/SQL/web/native code; only catalog-audit metadata differs from its application revision. Both real HTTP and installed native journeys completed successfully.
- All nine SQL property suites and ten concurrency groups pass on fresh PostgreSQL 17, including six record-publication withdrawal interleavings. Coverage includes authoritative counts, duplicate requests, parent deletion, blocking, mention privacy, permission revocation, reports and pause admission. The publication regression failed before repair; focused actual HTTP tests now pass for all three record kinds. Nonempty migration/reapplication tests preserve historical engagement and reporting evidence. Release-tool tests, specification inventory and catalog authority audit pass.
- All 45 review threads are resolved. The final hidden-root finding targeted a superseded pagination function: actual HTTP tests on the existing schema prove redacted hidden roots, visible descendants/counts, all sorts, cursor reply pages and deep links for anonymous/owner/author/ordinary viewers, plus disappearance of empty placeholders. No code change was needed. Web verification includes rendered permissions/focus/rollback, 19 publication-selection regressions and browser journeys across five desktop/mobile configurations with accessibility checks. The staging repair adds eight regression cases within 22 passing focused rendered tests; type/lint pass. Latest refresh/selection tests pass 27 focused cases; 65 release checks, three inventory tests and the catalog audit also pass. The final record-destination fix adds 12 rendered regressions (36 focused tests pass) plus real-API checks on Chromium desktop/phone/tablet, Firefox and WebKit, including bounded lookups, focus, keyboard collapse/expansion and axe checks without serious/critical violations.
- Native PR #124 merged normally; 553 tests, type/lint, rendered focus checks and Expo startup passed. The matching [installed Android journey](https://github.com/diegueins680/TDF-mobile/actions/runs/36520750030) and [schema-157 HTTP + installed iOS journey](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36657712401) pass login, reactions, comments, exact reply notification focus, editing, parent deletion with replies preserved, and collapse/expand. The [earlier installed iOS run](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/36659729464) also passed. Final-schema iOS qualification is linked above.
- A fresh encrypted off-host production backup restored successfully, accepted/reapplied all 159 migrations, remains paused after activation/retry/resume tests, and retains all 77 notifications. Exact legacy source/migrated counts agree. The final quiesced 11:13 UTC encrypted backup was captured, restored and rehearsed before live migration. The fresh 10:37 UTC encrypted production backup restored into an isolated PostgreSQL 17 database; the exact merged 159-entry manifest applied twice, and activation/retry/pause/resume passed with 77 notifications retained. Its rolled-back 10,000-comment/2,000-reaction benchmark measured 18.4 ms summary, 6.8 ms roots, 5.1 ms replies and 4.7 ms deep context.
- Signed Android 22/iOS 29 pass artifact identity, production API/runtime and configured associated-domain checks. Android 22 is now active and available to testers in the existing Alpha closed-test track. Apple validation/direct upload of unchanged iOS 29 succeeded; Apple reports `VALID`, internal beta testing and readiness for external beta submission. No external beta review/public store release was requested. Physical VoiceOver/TalkBack and installed signed HTTPS associations remain unverified.

**Merged, deployed and activated.** Production runs exact merge `645f56fcc44f81609fbfd0e03d683b40376ce77a`, immutable image `sha256:38e6264b82db2d81a5b51c3a78740b6a305538b4cdae8d53ced067ccbb1e8fe0`, with all 159 migrations applied. Health/database checks pass. The fresh quiesced encrypted backup was restored and rehearsed before cutover. Canonical activation retained all 77 existing notifications and matched legacy conversion counts; the release lease is released.

Cloudflare deployment `2e2a984b-f3c9-4391-9cc9-95fa20daac8d` serves the exact merge. Native association documents pass HTTP/content checks on both hosts, including Apple association user agents. Automatic production builds are restored, the owned temporary hook is deleted, and existing source/build/env/binding settings are preserved. Trader and its shared Fly database remain untouched.

Owned live API canaries passed reactions/change/removal/counts, idempotence, comment/reply/mention permissions, edit authorization, notification dispatch/exact links, owner hide/restore, tombstones and blocking. Desktop/phone browser journeys passed authoring/edit/delete, focus/disclosure/reconciliation and axe without serious/critical findings. Canary source content is hidden, bodies deleted and credentials revoked. The production focus defect was repaired in merged PR #473. Merged PR #474 then patched a newly updated dependency advisory. The final web release is `49f1f0ec087067d17f62d91df1b616eb053eb894`; all post-merge checks and actual desktop/phone/WebKit focus and accessibility flows pass.

Android 22 is active and available to existing Google Play Alpha testers; iOS 29 is valid and in internal beta testing. Public store release, physical VoiceOver/TalkBack and installed signed HTTPS handoff are not claimed. Post-activation recovery uses a compatible pause and fix forward; never downgrade to legacy writers or restore over new interactions.

Architecture/invariants: `docs/interactions/implementation.md`, `formal/interactions/README.md`. Migration/recovery: `docs/interactions/rollout.md`. Verification: `docs/interactions/verification-2026-09-30.md` (updated production evidence accompanies the web focus follow-up).

Final deployment/verification evidence and remaining physical-device limits: https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/474. Automatic Cloudflare production deployment is restored and all owned temporary canaries are retired.
